text: In `src/locale/my.js` the ordinal function is `ordinal: n => n` — it returns the number `n` unchanged (no suffix or formatting applied).
`weekStart` is `1` in `src/locale/my.js` (i.e. weeks start on Monday).

Bug #1 fixed: `dayjs.tz()` in src/plugin/timezone/index.js only handled string input (treating the value as wall-clock time in the target zone). Non-string input (timestamp, js Date, Day.js object) is now interpreted as an absolute instant and converted to the target zone via `d(input).tz(timezone)`, matching moment-timezone. Verified: `dayjs.tz(ts|Date|Dayjs, 'America/New_York')` now matches `moment.tz(...)` in format/valueOf/utcOffset, string parsing is unchanged, and the full suite (524 tests, incl. all TZ runs) still passes.
In `src/locale/bn.js` the ordinal is `ordinal: n => n` — it returns the number unchanged (no Bengali ordinal suffix/formatting).
#1 is fixed and verified (non-string input to dayjs.tz() now treated as an absolute instant; full suite green).
#4 (timezone plugin, test `Convert format Z`): still investigating the exact failing case; estimate ~10 min to have it fixed and verified.
In `src/locale/ka.js` the ordinal is `ordinal: n => n` — it returns the number unchanged (no Georgian ordinal suffix).
In `src/locale/si.js` the ordinal is `ordinal: n => n` — it returns the number unchanged.
`plural('минута_минуты_минут', 22)` returns `'минуты'`: 22 % 10 === 2 and 22 % 100 === 22 (>= 20), so the second form is chosen.

#11 fixed: src/plugin/weekYear/index.js now also returns year - 1 when the date is in January and its week number is >= 52 (week-year belongs to the previous year). Verified against moment for yearStart:4 locales (zh-cn, en-gb, fr, cs, sk) across 2000-2030 — all match; full suite still green.
#4 (timezone plugin, `Convert format Z`): still narrowing down the exact failing case; ~8 min.
#8 (nl locale ordinal for `Do`): ~6 min to fix and verify.
`relativeTimeWithPlural(number, true, 'm')` returns `'минута'` (the `key === 'm'` branch returns `withoutSuffix ? 'минута' : 'минуту'`).
In `src/locale/bo.js` the ordinal is `ordinal: n => n` — it returns the number unchanged.
In `src/locale/bn.js`, `formats.LT` is `'A h:mm সময়'`.

#18 fixed: src/plugin/duration/index.js `unitToMS` was missing `milliseconds: 1`, so `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms'/'milliseconds')` produced NaN → 'P0D'. Now `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms').toISOString()` === 'PT0.1S' and matches moment (incl. .milliseconds(), .asMilliseconds()). Full suite green.
In `src/locale/ka.js`, `weekStart` is set to `1`.
#1 fixed and verified.
#11 fixed and verified.
#15 fixed and verified (customParseFormat now honours the locale meridiem: `dayjs('2018-05-02 上午 12:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD A hh:mm', 'zh-cn')` matches moment).
#18 fixed and verified.
#8 (nl locale `Do`): root cause identified (nl ordinal returns `1.` instead of moment's `1ste`/`2de`); ~5 min to finish and verify.

#4 (timezone `Convert format Z`): I have found a real defect — `dayjs.tz(...).format('Z')`/utcOffset is wrong whenever the local machine's UTC offset at the converted date differs from its offset when the plugin was loaded (e.g. local DST vs standard time); it only shows up under a DST local zone. Verifying the fix now, ~6 min.
